q3_neutral_counting.ruling: a bare species name counts ions summed over charge states, neutrals excluded
q3_neutral_counting.what_the_writer_saw: the linked sibling StandardName oxygen_density, whose stored description reads 'Total number density of oxygen atoms and ions across all charge states, from neutral to fully stripped', and whose documentation sums Z=0..8. boron_density reads 'Elemental boron number density, summed over neutral atoms and all ionic charge states through fully stripped B5+'.
q3_neutral_counting.verdict_for_oxygen_density: the refusal is the RIGHT outcome for this name, and the ruling for it is a rename. Its source really does include neutrals: it is an elemental atom density, not an ion density. Regenerating it under the settled population sentence would publish a definition that contradicts its own DD source.
q3_neutral_counting.verdict_for_boron_density: same: the DD source includes neutrals, so the name is wrong and the ruling is a rename, not a docs edit.
q3_neutral_counting.is_the_writer_defective: no. The writer reproduced the linked name's stored text accurately. The defect is upstream in the bulk pass, which applied a blanket species-population hint to names whose source includes neutral atoms: the gate then correctly refused the only text the source supports.
q3_neutral_counting.note_on_neutral_species_density: volume_averaged_neutral_species_density is excluded from the population rule by docs_gates.is_species_density_name (neutral_species is an aggregate subject), yet the bulk pass applied the species hint to it and drove three rotations against text that was already right for its name.

repairs.defect: generate_docs gives the model every settled shared part verbatim (shared_parts), but refine_docs built neither the context key nor a template block. The renderer still installs the stored sentence and the persistence gate refuses a paraphrase, so every rotation re-guesses wording it cannot land and spends a rotation until the escalation seat happens to reproduce it.
